module.name: error-state
module.title: ErrorState
module.description: The ErrorState renderer and its options.

ui.name: error-state
ui.summary: Renders a failed region with a retry.
ui.guidance: role="alert" because a region that failed after the user acted must be announced - unlike EmptyState, which is a resting state and not news. The retry is a real link with an hx-get, so it works with scripts disabled.
